Best Sellers

A few favorites worth coming back for.

Best Seller

Garlic Chicken

Crispy fried chicken coated in a rich, savory-sweet garlic glaze and finished with sesame seeds. Crunchy on the outside, juicy inside, and packed with bold flavor.

Crispy Favorite

Crispy Fish Fillet

Tender fish pieces coated in a golden, crunchy breading. Crisp on the outside while staying soft and delicate inside.

Classic Favorite

Filipino-Style Spaghetti

Comforting spaghetti coated in a rich, creamy tomato sauce and topped with generous slices of hotdog for that familiar sweet-savory flavor.

Seafood Favorite

Shrimp Tempura

Plump shrimp coated in a light, golden breading and fried until crisp, creating a satisfying crunch with tender shrimp in every bite.

Filipino Favorite

Afritada

A hearty Filipino favorite with tender meat, potatoes, carrots, and vegetables cooked together in a rich and savory sauce.
